problem:

Question 16
?

The acceleration a at time t of a particle P moving in the xy-plane is given by a=⟨0,5⟩.

Given that the particle is at the position (3,−3) and has velocity ⟨1,0⟩ when t=2, calculate the position vector of P at time t.

a
r=⟨t2+4,5t22+7⟩
b
r=⟨t+4,5t2+72−10t⟩
c
r=⟨t+1,5t22−10t+7⟩
d
r=⟨2t+4,5t2+72−5t⟩
e
r=⟨−t2+t+1,5t22−10t+17⟩
